# Sumanta Mukhopadhyay

> Fractional CTO, principal engineer and AI architect based in the United States and the UAE. Ontology and knowledge graphs, production RAG and agentic AI, private LLMs, healthcare data (FHIR, OMOP, HIPAA), scalable data platforms (1M+ transactions/day) and multi-cloud infrastructure.

Contact: sumantamukhopadhyaywork@gmail.com · Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/fpARv4QHsYCLMo3a8

## Services
- [Fractional CTO](https://caeser1996.github.io/fractional-cto/): Part-time, senior technology leadership. A fractional CTO for strategy, architecture, hiring and board reporting, from first AI product to scale. US & UAE.
- [AI & LLM architecture](https://caeser1996.github.io/ai-architect/): AI and LLM architecture that ships: production RAG and GraphRAG, LangGraph agents, MCP, LLM evaluation and private on-prem models. Strategy to production.
- [Ontology & knowledge graphs](https://caeser1996.github.io/ontology-knowledge-graph/): Ontology engineering and knowledge graph consulting: shared business semantics, entity resolution, semantic layers and GraphRAG that make data and AI agree.
- [Healthcare data architecture](https://caeser1996.github.io/healthcare-data-architecture/): Healthcare data architecture consulting: HL7 FHIR interoperability, OMOP CDM and OHDSI research platforms, HIPAA-aligned cloud and clinical AI with guardrails.
- [Technical due diligence](https://caeser1996.github.io/technical-due-diligence/): Independent technical and AI due diligence for VC, PE and corporate investors: architecture, code, team, security, scalability and a value-creation plan.
- [Fractional CTO in the UAE](https://caeser1996.github.io/uae/): Fractional CTO and AI consultant for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the GCC: AI strategy, data platforms and cloud, built for UAE PDPL, DIFC, ADGM and data residency.

## Insights
- [Securing MCP servers for enterprise AI agents: an architect's checklist](https://caeser1996.github.io/insights/securing-mcp-servers-checklist/): A practical checklist for running Model Context Protocol servers in production: token audience, confused deputy, least privilege, gateways, logging and prompt injection.
- [The EU AI Act after the Digital Omnibus: what actually changes for your AI roadmap](https://caeser1996.github.io/insights/eu-ai-act-digital-omnibus-roadmap/): The Digital Omnibus pushed EU AI Act high-risk deadlines to December 2027 and August 2028. What moved, what didn't, and how I'd adjust an AI roadmap now.
- [Running private LLMs on your own hardware: notes from the bench](https://caeser1996.github.io/insights/private-llm-on-prem/): Notes on private, on-prem LLMs for regulated data: model sizing, quantisation, LoRA fine-tuning, routing between local and hosted models, and an AI gateway.
- [FHIR to OMOP: a practical architecture for healthcare data](https://caeser1996.github.io/insights/fhir-to-omop-architecture/): How FHIR and OMOP CDM fit together: a reference pipeline from clinical sources through terminology mapping to OHDSI cohorts, with de-identification and HIPAA.
- [From RAG demo to production: a checklist](https://caeser1996.github.io/insights/rag-to-production-checklist/): A practitioner's checklist for taking RAG from demo to production: retrieval quality, evaluation, guardrails, permissions, cost per query and rollout.
- [Ontology vs knowledge graph vs semantic layer: what's the difference, and which do you need?](https://caeser1996.github.io/insights/ontology-vs-knowledge-graph-vs-semantic-layer/): Clear definitions of ontologies, knowledge graphs and semantic layers, how they fit together, when to use each, and how they make LLMs and RAG more accurate.
- [When do you need a fractional CTO? (And when you don't)](https://caeser1996.github.io/insights/when-do-you-need-a-fractional-cto/): Signs you need a fractional CTO, how it compares with interim, full-time and agency options, what the first 90 days look like, and how a clean handover works.
